output.description: Output file (relative to the config file).

stdout.description: Write the document to stdout instead of a file.

mode.description: Strip function bodies (skeleton), include raw source (full) or list declarations only (outline).

focus.description: Files, directories or globs kept as full source.

clipboard.description: Copy the document to the clipboard.

include.description: Only include files matching these patterns (merged with --include).

maxFileSize.description: Skip files larger than this (bytes or e.g. "1mb").

fallbackLines.description: Max lines kept from unsupported files in skeleton mode.

fallbackChars.description: Max characters kept from unsupported files in skeleton mode.

comments.description: Comments to keep outside focused files.

maxTokens.description: Token budget for the document (e.g. 100000 or "100k").

splitTokens.description: Split the output into parts of at most this many tokens.

instructions.description: Instructions placed at the top (prefix with @ to read a file).

changed.description: Focus files changed vs a git ref (true = HEAD).

diff.description: Include the git diff vs a ref (true = the --changed ref or HEAD).

models.description: Models to price in the summary.

claudeTokens.description: Count Claude tokens exactly via the Anthropic API (sends the document).

top.description: Number of largest files listed in the summary.

preset.description: Ready-made options and instructions for a task.
